study type: Pilot interventional study with control group
cohort: Eight women (4 in VR group, 4 in control group) undergoing elective cesarean delivery under epidural analgesia.
finding: Patients in the VR group experienced a 91.89% pain reduction, compared to a 61% increase in pain in the control group, and VR also provided high levels of satisfaction.
mod_finding: VR supplementation provided significant pain mitigation and high satisfaction specifically during elective cesarean delivery.
